title: The Groq deal shows the challenges Nvidia faces as options to deploy its cash flood narrow; its annual free cash flow has risen from $4.2B in 2020 to $80B+ now (Dan Gallagher/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Dan Gallagher / Wall Street Journal: The Groq deal shows the challenges Nvidia faces as options to deploy its cash flood narrow; its annual free cash flow has risen from $4.2B in 2020 to $80B+ now — Blowout AI spending fills chip maker's coffers, but Groq deal shows that company needs to think creatively
